# Measured error bounds

Generated by `python3 harness/run.py --samples 1000 --seed 20261115` with `fe 26.6.0 (5b3f96a)`. Every value below was produced by running the Fe code on the `fe test` EVM backend and comparing it with a 110-digit `decimal` (or exact rational) reference.

*ulp* = one unit of the raw representation (1e-18 for Wad/SWad, 1e-27 for Ray/SRay). Results below 1.0 are judged by absolute error in ulps, results of at least 1.0 by relative error. For functions with a rounding contract the harness also checks the exact expected integer; `violations` counts mismatches.
